summary_hint: institution, account type, statement period, ending balance

typed_core.name: institution_name
typed_core.why: AS-8, AS-10 — account grouping key (with the masked number)

typed_core.name: account_holder_names_raw
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the holder line verbatim before splitting; if the split is wrong ('JORDAN AND ROBERT CHEN' may be one person or two) the tag layer can see the original
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the account-holder line VERBATIM before any splitting

typed_core.name: account_owner_name
typed_core.why: AS-6 (ownership match), ID-1 (name consistency)

typed_core.name: account_owner_name_2
typed_core.why: AS-6 — a joint account with a non-borrower co-holder is Priya's flagged case; today only one holder is captured so a co-owner is invisible
typed_core.prompt_hint: If two holders are named, set both name fields and the count

typed_core.name: account_owner_count
typed_core.why: AS-6 disambiguator — how many owners the raw string resolved to

typed_core.name: account_holder_address
typed_core.why: ID-4 (address consistency), OC-1 (occupancy signals) — currently not extracted, so those rules get nothing from a statement

typed_core.name: account_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII; the account-grouping key for AS-8/AS-10
typed_core.prompt_hint: Last 4 digits only — never the full account number

typed_core.name: account_type
typed_core.why: AS-4 (reserve eligibility differs by type), AS-3 (liquid vs not)
typed_core.prompt_hint: checking / savings / money market / CD, as stated

typed_core.name: account_status
typed_core.why: AS-4 — a closed account cannot be a reserve source

typed_core.name: statement_period_start
typed_core.why: AS-8 (continuity), AS-10 (enough months)

typed_core.name: statement_period_end
typed_core.why: AS-8, AS-10, recency

typed_core.name: declared_page_count
typed_core.why: AS-9 — 'extract the declared page count and compare to the actual'
typed_core.prompt_hint: The count PRINTED on the statement ('Page 1 of 4'), NOT the PDF page count

typed_core.name: beginning_balance
typed_core.why: AS-8 — the chain's left side

typed_core.name: ending_balance
typed_core.why: AS-8 chain, AS-3 cash-to-close, AS-4 reserves

typed_core.name: available_balance
typed_core.why: AS-3 — differs from ending when holds exist

typed_core.name: average_daily_balance
typed_core.why: AS-4 — a large-deposit-inflated ending balance is visible against the average

typed_core.name: total_deposits
typed_core.why: AS-1, AS-12 — cross-check against the transaction sum

typed_core.name: total_withdrawals
typed_core.why: AS-1, AS-12

typed_core.name: nsf_fee_count
typed_core.why: AS-7 — currently blocked with no producer; a stated count is a deterministic path that skips per-transaction AI classification
typed_core.prompt_hint: Only if the statement SUMMARISES it — do not count transactions yourself

typed_core.name: nsf_fee_total
typed_core.why: AS-7

typed_core.name: fees_total
typed_core.why: processor reference; distinguishes NSF fees from generic service charges

typed_core.name: minimum_balance_requirement
typed_core.why: AS-4 — a required minimum is not freely available for reserves

typed_core.name: holds_or_pledges
typed_core.why: AS-4 — pledged or held funds are not reserve-eligible
typed_core.prompt_hint: Any statement that funds are held, pledged, or restricted

typed_core.name: interest_paid
typed_core.why: processor reference

nested_lists.name: transactions
nested_lists.shape_reason: a 4-month statement carries 200+ line items; per-field wrapping would risk the 16,384-token output ceiling

fields.name: description
fields.why: AS-5 gift detection, AS-7 NSF lines, FR-5 recurring debits
fields.pii_note: incidental PII — needs a row redactor, not _PII_FIELDS

fields.name: amount
fields.why: AS-1 large-deposit sweep, AS-2/PC-5 EMD match

rejected.name: large_deposit_candidates
rejected.reason: a judgment, not a fact — AS-1's job, computed from transactions against an income-derived threshold. Tags describe; rules judge

rejected.name: notary_block / signature_blocks
rejected.reason: a bank statement is not executed

rejected.name: account_owner_names as person[]
rejected.reason: a 1-3 element list costs ~5 plumbing sites; resolved flat with the raw string retained

encoding_variations: Every institution formats differently — layout, section names, transaction table shape
Joint holders appear as 'A AND B', 'A & B', 'A/B', or on separate lines
NSF fees may be summarised, itemised among transactions, or both
Page count appears as 'Page 1 of 4' — the printed count, not the PDF's
Balances may print with CR or parentheses for credits

open_questions.recommendation: flat — a 1-3 element list is not worth ~5 plumbing sites; the raw string preserves auditability

open_questions.q: Should the extractor populate nsf_fee_count now, when AS-7 is still blocked on a producer?
open_questions.recommendation: populate now — if statements commonly state an NSF count, AS-7 becomes deterministic and skips per-transaction AI entirely

notes: The shipping extractor already implements page_count_declared AND page_count_present — it is ahead of the v2 catalog, which omits the field entirely.
A real catch-all was observed holding an unmasked home address and SSN; account_holder_address is promoted to typed core partly to protect it.
